question:
Choose the correct word to complete the sentence.
The fisherman rowed his small ______ to the shore.
solution:
The correct answer is '**boat**'.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word "**boat**" refers to a small vessel used for traveling on water, which is appropriate in the given context.
 
• The sentence describes the fisherman rowing his vessel to the shore, making "**boat**" the correct choice.</li
